label: Transformed Jamesian pragmatism and stream of consciousness into social interactionist psychology
description: George Herbert Mead adopted William James's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from William James's perspective to George Herbert Mead's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 19th Century Divergences across history into the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis.

label: Theorized how role-taking and the generalized other construct self-consciousness
description: George Herbert Mead formulated and introduced the concept of "The Generalized Other", which became a seminal contribution in symbolic-interactionism philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in symbolic-interactionism.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of George Herbert Mead's canonical writings.

label: Goffman developed Mead's social self into dramaturgical impression management
description: Erving Goffman adopted George Herbert Mead's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from George Herbert Mead's perspective to Erving Goffman's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.

label: Habermas integrated Mead's communicative gestures into the theory of communicative action
description: Jürgen Habermas adopted George Herbert Mead's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from George Herbert Mead's perspective to Jürgen Habermas's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
